# uzc_affinity_group (Resource)

Manages a UzCloud affinity group. There is no update endpoint, so changing any attribute recreates the resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_affinity_group" "example" {
  name           = "example-affinity-group"
  type           = "host anti-affinity"
  cloud_provider = "nimbo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String) e.g. "host affinity".

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `project` (String) Project slug. Falls back to the provider's `project` default when unset.
- `region` (String) Region slug. Falls back to the provider's `region` default when unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same value as `slug`. Used as the Terraform resource ID.
- `slug` (String) Server-assigned slug, used in the delete endpoint's path and for import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_affinity_group.example <affinity-group-slug>
```
